case_title: PAGPAGUITAN ANTONIA VS RIEGO ELIZABETH et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,200.00 FILED BY PAGPAGUITAN ANTONIA AS TO DEFENDANT RIEGO ELIZABETH RIEGO WILFREDO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-26-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT RIEGO ELIZABETH

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT RIEGO ELIZABETH RIEGO WILFREDO LACK OF JURISDICTION, STATUTE OF LIMITATION HAD RUN AGAINST PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
